title: 📦 How to Consolidate and Ship Your Items from the Warehouse?
content:
If your items have arrived at our China warehouse and you want to ship them to your country, this guide will help you understand the next steps.

You can ship one item alone, or combine multiple items into one parcel. This process is called consolidation.


🌟 Simple overview

After your items arrive at our warehouse, the shipping process usually includes these steps:

  1. Go to your warehouse page
  2. Select the items you want to ship
  3. Choose whether to consolidate items
  4. Select optional warehouse services
  5. Confirm your shipping address
  6. Choose an international shipping method
  7. Submit the parcel
  8. Pay the international shipping fee
  9. Wait for warehouse packing and dispatch
  10. Track your international parcel


1. 🏠 Go to your warehouse page

After an item arrives at our China warehouse, it will appear in your warehouse account.

You can usually find it under:

  • My Warehouse
  • Warehouse Items
  • Stored Items
  • Ready to Ship

On this page, you can check:

  • Item name
  • Item photo
  • Quantity
  • Warehouse status
  • Item weight, if available
  • Storage time
  • Whether the item has any abnormal status

Only items that have arrived and are ready to ship can be submitted for international shipping.


2. ✅ Select the items you want to ship

Choose the items you want to send to your country.

You can choose:

  • One item only
  • Several items from different orders
  • All items currently in your warehouse
  • Some items now and leave others for later

Before selecting items, please check carefully:

  • Is the item correct?
  • Is the quantity correct?
  • Do you need to return or exchange it?
  • Do you need to wait for more items to arrive?
  • Is the item allowed to be shipped to your country?

Once the parcel is submitted and processed, it may not be easy to cancel or modify.


3. 📦 What is consolidation?

Consolidation means combining multiple warehouse items into one international parcel.

For example, if you bought clothes, shoes, phone cases, and accessories from different sellers, they may arrive at our warehouse separately.

After all items arrive, you can combine them into one parcel and ship them together.


4. 💡 Why consolidate items?

Consolidation may be helpful because it can:

  • Reduce repeated first-weight shipping costs
  • Make parcel management easier
  • Allow multiple items to arrive together
  • Help you choose one shipping method for many items
  • Reduce the number of international tracking numbers

For many users, consolidation is a convenient way to ship several items together.


5. ⚠️ Is consolidation always cheaper?

Not always.

Consolidation may reduce costs in many cases, but the final fee depends on the actual parcel weight and size.

If the combined parcel becomes very large, the shipping method may calculate the fee based on volume weight.

For example:

  • Combining several T-shirts may be cheaper
  • Combining many large boxes may increase package size
  • Keeping shoe boxes may increase volume weight
  • Large plush toys may make the parcel much bigger

The final shipping fee will be calculated after the parcel is packed or measured according to the shipping method rules.


6. 🛠️ Choose optional warehouse services

Before submitting the parcel, you may be able to choose optional warehouse services.

Common services include:

  • Repacking
  • Removing outer packaging
  • Keeping original boxes
  • Reinforcement
  • Waterproof packaging
  • Bubble wrap protection
  • Extra photos
  • Fragile item protection
  • Package splitting
  • Special notes or labels

Some services may be free, while others may require an additional fee.

Please choose based on your item type and shipping needs.


7. 📷 When should I request extra photos?

You may request extra photos if:

  • You want to check product details
  • You are not sure about the item color or style
  • The item looks different from what you expected
  • You want to confirm quantity before shipping
  • The item is valuable
  • The item may have visible defects

Please note that extra photos are usually a visual check only. They are not professional quality inspection, brand authentication, size measurement, or functional testing unless a special service is available.


8. 🛡️ When should I choose reinforcement?

Reinforcement may be useful for:

  • Fragile items
  • Glass products
  • Electronics
  • Collectibles
  • Shoes with boxes
  • Gifts
  • Expensive items
  • Items with weak original packaging

Reinforcement can help protect your parcel during transportation.

However, it may increase the package weight or size, which may also affect the shipping fee.


9. ✂️ When should I remove packaging?

Removing unnecessary packaging may help reduce package size.

It may be useful for:

  • Shoes, if you do not need the shoe box
  • Clothes with bulky packaging
  • Items with large outer boxes
  • Products bought only for personal use
  • Items that do not need original retail packaging

Please note: removing packaging may reduce protection. For fragile, collectible, or gift items, please consider carefully before removing the original box.


10. 📍 Confirm your shipping address

Before submitting your parcel, please confirm your shipping address carefully.

Please check:

  • Recipient name
  • Phone number
  • Country or region
  • State or province
  • City
  • Postal code
  • Street address
  • Apartment, unit, or building number

Incorrect address information may cause delivery failure, return, extra fees, or parcel loss.

If your country requires tax ID, ID number, or customs information, please fill it in correctly.


11. 🚚 Choose an international shipping method

After selecting your items and services, choose an international shipping method.

Different shipping methods may have different:

  • Prices
  • Delivery times
  • Weight limits
  • Size limits
  • Item restrictions
  • Tracking availability
  • Customs handling rules
  • Tax handling rules
  • Compensation rules

Please choose a method based on:

  • Your destination country
  • Product type
  • Budget
  • Delivery time requirement
  • Whether the item is sensitive or restricted
  • Whether you need detailed tracking

If you are not sure which method to choose, please contact customer service before submitting the parcel.


12. 💳 Pay the international shipping fee

After you submit the parcel, the system will calculate the international shipping fee.

The fee may be based on:

  • Destination country
  • Shipping method
  • Actual weight
  • Package size
  • Chargeable weight
  • Optional services
  • Product type
  • Route rules

After you pay the international shipping fee, our warehouse will prepare your parcel for packing and dispatch.


13. 🧾 What happens after payment?

After your international shipping fee is paid, the warehouse will process your parcel.

The process may include:

  • Checking selected items
  • Repacking or reinforcing, if requested
  • Measuring weight and size
  • Printing shipping labels
  • Handing the parcel to the logistics provider
  • Updating the tracking number

Once the parcel is shipped, you can check the tracking information in your account.


14. 🌍 Track your parcel

After dispatch, your parcel will enter international transportation.

Tracking updates may include:

  • Parcel received by logistics provider
  • Departed from warehouse
  • Arrived at sorting center
  • Export customs processing
  • Flight or transit update
  • Arrived in destination country
  • Import customs clearance
  • Local delivery
  • Delivered

Please note that international tracking may not update every day. Some routes only update after the parcel reaches a major transit point or the destination country.


Important notes

  • Only warehouse items that are ready to ship can be submitted for international shipping.
  • Please confirm item information before submitting your parcel.
  • Consolidation may reduce shipping costs, but it is not guaranteed.
  • Large parcels may be charged by volume weight.
  • Extra packaging can protect items but may increase shipping cost.
  • Removing packaging may reduce size, but may also reduce protection.
  • Please check your shipping address carefully before payment.
  • Once the parcel is packed or shipped, it may not be possible to cancel or modify.
  • Some items may be restricted or prohibited by certain shipping methods.
  • Customs duties or import taxes may be charged by your destination country.


Frequently Asked Questions

Q1: Can I ship only one item?

Yes. You can submit one item for international shipping if it is already stored in the warehouse and ready to ship.

Q2: Can I combine items from different orders?

Yes. If the items are all stored in your warehouse account and ready to ship, you can usually combine them into one parcel.

Q3: Is consolidation always cheaper?

No. Consolidation may reduce repeated shipping costs, but if the parcel becomes too large, volume weight may increase the final shipping fee.

Q4: Can I add more items after submitting a parcel?

If the warehouse has not started processing the parcel, it may be possible to cancel or modify it. If the parcel is already being packed or shipped, changes may not be possible. Please contact customer service as soon as possible.

Q5: Can I remove the shoe box to reduce shipping cost?

In many cases, yes. Removing shoe boxes may reduce package size. However, it may also reduce protection. Please choose based on your needs.

Q6: What if I entered the wrong shipping address?

Please contact customer service immediately. If the parcel has not been shipped, the address may still be changed. If the parcel has already been dispatched, changes may not be possible or may require extra fees.

Q7: Why is the parcel still not shipped after I paid?

The warehouse may need time to pack, measure, label, and hand over the parcel to the logistics provider. If the status does not update for a long time, please contact customer service with your parcel number.


Need help?

If you are not sure how to consolidate or ship your items, please contact our customer service team before submitting the parcel.

To help us assist you faster, please provide:

  • Your parcel number, if available
  • The items you want to ship
  • Your destination country
  • Whether you want to remove packaging
  • Whether you need reinforcement
  • Your preferred delivery time
  • Any special shipping requirements

We will help you check the available options and guide you through the next step.
